Task.description: Worker retry_wait and waiting_external map to queued plus next_check_at; recovering maps to queued until reclaimed. phase describes waiting_run/recovery explicitly; queued is not active execution.

Validate and atomically consume browser-bound OAuth state including purpose. For login: verify bound tenant and application eligibility and create downloader-only session. Validate current password, reject an unchanged password, clear must_change_password, revoke all existing admin sessions and issue a fresh session. Available to an administrator whose initial password still needs changing.
Retry only permitted failed stage of same event; preserve successful cache entries/deliveries. Unknown notification outcomes need delivery-level explicit resend approval.

Revalidate Feishu eligibility (maximum cached age 300 seconds). Ready cache: 200 short-lived bearer URL. Cold cache: 202 preparation, no token; client must retry grant after ready. Grant is reusable until expiry for HEAD/Range; no-store. A replay of a 202 key remains 202; after ready use a NEW key to request the actual grant. Replayed 200 rechecks current eligibility and never extends expiry; expired grant requires a new key.

post.description: Dedicated bearer only. Persist unique rule+repository+run+attempt+release+sorted asset IDs before 202; return same event on duplicate. Verify provider run/repo/workflow/ref/SHA/assets asynchronously. Callback must not wait for source run terminal state or cache/notification. Same event identity but a different head_sha/payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Reject fork/PR runs and untrusted refs; verify release tag resolves to the run head SHA.
Retry definite failure. Unknown send outcome requires explicit acknowledge_possible_duplicate=true and audit; no silent replay.
